policies.void: Exact existing void-original-keep-one-v1 policy and complete Irida native source: attributed SendDeckToVoid, independent permanent player instance, two original GetFromVoid at actual own starts. Source retirement or control changes do not migrate or revoke original player instance. Empty/single pools, physical materials, overflow, sequential reactions and ordinary start draw remain native, pending exact CN selection/priority calibration.
policies.scope: One newly executable Standard candidate collectible, nine complete older Paladin/Mech collectibles and two directly named token dependencies. TIME_016 is unchanged and unsupported. Source text predicate plus complete metadata supports a candidate dependency audit; no source-specific pool, restricted subset, exact from-the-past pool certification or Wild format support is added.
policies.magnetic: Glow-Tron uses the existing native Magnetic keyword and explicit Mech recipients. Ordinary hand payment, original host, independent entry, current materials, silence and retirement are owned by the kernel.
policies.cobalt: Printed6/3 with a native own-other-successful-Mech-summon listener. It does not trigger on its own entry. Current ALL/Mech predicate and original source residency guard use public helpers; exact self-entry/trigger acceptance remains M6.
policies.reborn: Shotbot and Micro Mummy use native Reborn. Micro Mummy actual owner-end body selects one other currently live friendly minion through ordinary RandomBuff; empty candidates do not invent RNG or a target.
policies.bubble: Bubblebot captures all other current friendly Mech/ALL references once, granting ordinary Divine Shield and Taunt to each original recipient. Later same-ID reentry or transfer cannot take over delayed grants. No target protection filter is invented.
policies.summons: Mechano-Egg summons its exact8/8 Robosaur with original Deathrattle placement and attributed SummonByCard. Sky Claw has an ordinary other-Mech attack aura and two attributed Microcopter requests. Native capacity, summon quantity, copies, silence and death stay public.
policies.source_gaps: Chef five-turn/10-Mana meaning is not chosen by the adapter. Gorishi extra-damage recursion and logical-source boundary, and CAP_806 actual successful-Reborn history, remain whole-card handoffs. Their complete rows and strict primary faces are evidence only.
